title: Psalm 125: Like Mount Zion, Never Shaken
summary: Those who trust the LORD are compared to Mount Zion, which cannot be moved, and God's protection of his people is compared to the mountains that ring Jerusalem. The psalm promises that the rule of the wicked will not last over the land given to the righteous, prays for good to come to the upright, and sets apart those who turn to crooked ways, ending with a blessing of peace on Israel.

from.text: Psalm 120 opens the Songs of Ascents, a collection of fifteen short psalms (120 to 134) that each carry the heading

line: Those who trust the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken, and he surrounds his people as the mountains surround Jerusalem.
guide: You are steady not because you are strong but because God is around you. When unjust people hold power for a long time, it is easy to copy them; ask where you are tempted to reach for what is wrong because that seems to be how things work now.

stanzas.title: Secure like Zion, surrounded like Jerusalem
The wicked scepter will not rest on the land
Good for the upright, banishment for the crooked; peace on Israel

verses.t: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
